summary: MicroVision, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a securities purchase agreement for a confidentially marketed public offering of 6,800,000 shares of common stock and accompanying warrants. Securities sold at combined offering price of $2.50 per share plus warrant; warrants exercisable immediately at $2.50 for five years. WestPark Capital acted as sole placement agent, receiving 6.5% cash commission plus $115,000 expense reimbursement. Net proceeds approximately $15.6 million for general corporate purposes. Offering closed August 17, 2026. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
